home.heading: Welcome to the India Branch
home.intro: World Association for Al-Azhar Graduates – India is an academic and intellectual institution uniting Al-Azhar graduates across India, promoting Al-Azhar's message of moderation, scholarship, dialogue, and community service.
home.mission: To unite Al-Azhar graduates across India, foster academic and intellectual collaboration, spread moderate values across all sections of Indian society, support educational and research initiatives, and serve society through knowledge, dialogue, and constructive work.
home.vision: Building a strong national network of Al-Azhar graduates in India contributing to knowledge, peace, understanding, and human development.
home.motto: Moderation is our methodology, unity is our strength, knowledge is our identity, and service to humanity is our mission.

about.title: About Us
about.al_azhar_text: For over a millennium, Al-Azhar Al-Sharif has stood as a global beacon of knowledge, Islamic scholarship, and moderate thought. Throughout history, it has nurtured generations of scholars, thinkers, and educators who have served communities across the globe.
about.world_assoc_text: Established in Cairo in 2006, the World Association for Al-Azhar Graduates fosters lifelong ties with alumni worldwide, building an international platform for intellectual, scientific, and cultural collaboration.
about.world_assoc_patron: The association functions under the patronage of His Eminence Prof. Dr. Ahmed El-Tayeb, Grand Imam of Al-Azhar.
about.india_branch_p1: The India Branch was officially inaugurated in Lucknow on November 14, 2010, and established its central office in New Delhi on November 14, 2011, expanding nationwide outreach.
about.india_branch_p2: The branch unites Al-Azhar graduates across India, promoting moderate Islamic thought, educational excellence, academic cooperation, and community welfare.
about.distinctive_text: Non-partisan and independent, the association welcomes scholars and community members from all backgrounds, fostering brotherhood, intellectual exchange, and mutual respect.

objectives.title: Our Objectives
items: Highlight Al-Azhar Al-Sharif's academic and civilisational contributions globally.
Connect Al-Azhar graduates across India into a cohesive national network.
Promote academic collaboration, research, and intellectual dialogue.
Disseminate values of moderation, balance, mutual respect, and tolerance.
Support Arabic language education and classical Islamic sciences.
Organise academic conferences, intellectual seminars, and training programs.
Nurture youth leadership and intellectual capacity development.
Foster peaceful coexistence, interfaith dialogue, and societal harmony.
Present the authentic, compassionate teachings and human values of Islam.
Support scholarly research and outreach initiatives of Al-Azhar alumni.
Connect Indian scholars with international academic platforms.

activities.title: Our Activities & Programs
activities.academic_text: Comprehensive academic and educational programs designed to promote lifelong learning, research, and scholarly development.
activities.arabic_text: Conducting specialized workshops, intensive diploma courses, and certificate programs in Arabic language and linguistics.
activities.hadith_text: Scholarly lectures and study circles focused on Quranic interpretation, prophetic traditions, and jurisprudence.
activities.lectures_text: Online lectures and webinars led by eminent professors and scholars from Al-Azhar University, Cairo.
activities.humanitarian_text: Promoting social solidarity through healthcare drives, support for underserved families, educational scholarships, and community relief.
activities.empowerment_text: Empowering Indian scholars through international academic exposure, teacher training, and scholarly publication opportunities.

impact.title: Our Impact in Numbers
impact.dialogues: Numerous goodwill meetings and academic dialogues.
impact.cooperation: Promoting educational cooperation between Indian scholars and Al-Azhar.

conferences.title: Conferences & Events
conferences.peace_conf_subtitle: The Need and Importance of Peace and Peaceful Coexistence in the Contemporary World
conferences.peace_conf_desc: In 2017, the India Branch hosted the landmark International Peace Conference at the India Islamic Cultural Centre, New Delhi, attended by eminent scholars, academics, and dignitaries from India and abroad.
conferences.peace_conf_guest: Special participation by Prof. Dr. Yousuf Amer, then Vice President of Al-Azhar University.
conferences.peace_conf_focus: The conference reinforced shared human values, moderate religious discourse, dialogue, and peaceful coexistence.

president_message.title: Message From The President
president_message.bismillah: In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
president_message.salutation: Peace and blessings be upon the Messenger of Allah, and upon his family and companions.
president_message.p1: It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to the official portal of the World Association for Al-Azhar Graduates – India Branch. This platform unites Al-Azhar graduates across India under a shared banner of brotherhood, academic collaboration, and faithful service to the noble mission of Al-Azhar Al-Sharif.
president_message.p2: For over a thousand years, Al-Azhar Al-Sharif has stood as an illuminating lighthouse of knowledge and a fortress of moderate Islamic thought. Al-Azhar alumni in India have consistently made profound contributions towards communal harmony, interfaith understanding, national development, and humanitarian service.
president_message.p3: Guided by this responsibility, the India Branch is committed to strengthening bonds among alumni, fostering research and scholarly excellence, nurturing youth potential, and implementing impactful educational and social welfare initiatives.
president_message.p4: I warmly invite all Al-Azhar graduates throughout India to join hands with the association, participate actively in its programs, and dedicate their learning and experience to the betterment of our nation and humanity.
president_message.signatory_name: Prof. Dr. Mohammad Mubeen Saleem Al-Azhari
president_message.signatory_title: President, World Association for Al-Azhar Graduates – India Branch
president_message.p5: We pray to the Almighty to bless these endeavors, grant us all success in serving our faith, nation, and humanity, and make this organisation a beacon of knowledge, a bridge of dialogue, and a pillar of moderation and community service.

identity_items.title: The Path of Moderation (Wasatiyyah)
identity_items.desc: Upholding balance, constructive dialogue, and mutual respect while firmly rejecting all forms of extremism and sectarianism.

identity_items.title: Universal Service to Humanity
identity_items.desc: Translating sacred knowledge into compassionate action, social upliftment, and human dignity for all sections of society.
